name: V_skill_test_tam_buildings_staging
sql:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM databricks_prd.dbt_production.fct_tam_buildings
  WHERE (
      lower(property_manager_name) LIKE '%'
      OR lower(key_tenant_name) LIKE '%'
      OR lower(owner_name) LIKE '%'
      OR lower(cust_parent_customer) LIKE '%'
    )
    AND property_id <> '10630US'
    AND coalesce(sector, '') <> 'Residential'
    AND outside_geographic_tam = 'F'
    AND (building_rba IS NULL OR building_rba >= 20000)
), derived AS (
  SELECT
    scoped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN customer_match_status = 'No Market ID'
        THEN coalesce(parent_cust_sf_estimate, 0) >= 100000
      WHEN customer_match_status IN ('Matched: In TAM', 'Not a Customer')
        THEN coalesce(building_rba, 0) >= 20000
          AND CASE
            WHEN lower(coalesce(trim(account), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
             AND lower(coalesce(trim(property_manager_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
             AND lower(coalesce(trim(owner_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
             AND lower(coalesce(trim(key_tenant_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
              THEN coalesce(building_rba, 0) >= 100000
            ELSE coalesce(account_sf_total, 0) >= 100000
              OR coalesce(property_manager_sf_total, 0) >= 100000
              OR coalesce(owner_sf_total, 0) >= 100000
              OR coalesce(key_tenant_sf_total, 0) >= 100000
          END
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default,
    CASE WHEN trim(consolidated_sector_2) = '' THEN NULL ELSE consolidated_sector_2 END AS consolidated_sector_2_semantic,
    coalesce(building_sf_occupied_by_account, customer_sf_estimate) AS building_sf_customer_adjusted,
    right(naics, 6) AS naics_code_semantic
  FROM scoped
)
SELECT
  derived.*,
  CASE
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Office' THEN 1
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Industrial' THEN 2
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Warehouse/Distribution' THEN 3
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Manufacturing' THEN 4
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Retail' THEN 5
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Specialty' THEN 6
    WHEN consolidated_sector_2_semantic = 'Healthcare' THEN 7
    ELSE 999
  END AS consolidated_sector_2_sort_semantic,
  CASE
    WHEN sector = 'Office - Multi-Tenant' THEN 1
    WHEN sector = 'Office - Single-Tenant' THEN 2
    WHEN sector = 'Flex' THEN 3
    WHEN sector = 'Hospitals' THEN 4
    WHEN sector = 'Long Term Care' THEN 5
    WHEN sector = 'Healthcare - General' THEN 6
    WHEN sector = 'Manufacturing' THEN 7
    WHEN sector = 'Warehouse/Distribution' THEN 8
    WHEN sector = 'Food Processing' THEN 9
    WHEN sector = 'Data Centers' THEN 10
    WHEN sector = 'Industrial - General' THEN 11
    WHEN sector = 'Retail - General' THEN 12
    WHEN sector = 'Freestanding and Department Stores' THEN 13
    WHEN sector = 'Shopping Malls' THEN 14
    WHEN sector = 'Airports' THEN 15
    WHEN sector = 'Airplane Hangars' THEN 16
    WHEN sector = 'Schools' THEN 17
    WHEN sector = 'Sports & Entertainment' THEN 18
    WHEN sector = 'Hotels & Hospitality' THEN 19
    WHEN sector = 'Other' THEN 20
    ELSE 999
  END AS sector_sort_semantic
FROM derived
description: Explore-filtered TAM staging with extended-scope flag

name: V_skill_test_tam_buildings
yaml:
version: "1.1"
source: databricks_prd.semantic_migration_dev.V_skill_test_tam_buildings_staging
dimensions:
  - name: sector
    expr: |-
      sector
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Facility Type
    comment: Detailed facility type used for granular TAM segmentation within the consolidated facility groups.
  - name: owner_name
    expr: |-
      owner_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Owner Name
    comment: Building owner organization.
    synonyms:
      - Owner Name
  - name: include_in_tam_owner
    expr: |-
      include_in_tam_owner
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Include In Tam Owner (Yes / No)
    synonyms:
      - Include In Tam Owner
  - name: cust_parent_customer
    expr: |-
      cust_parent_customer
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Parent Customer
    comment: Parent company rollup used for account-family analysis across multiple buildings and geographies.
    synonyms:
      - Cust Parent Customer
  - name: territory
    expr: |-
      territory
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Territory
    comment: Primary sales territory used for day-to-day TAM planning and performance management.
  - name: customer_match_status
    expr: |-
      customer_match_status
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Match Status
    comment: "TAM qualification category for each building (for example Matched: In TAM, No Market ID, Excluded categories, Outside Geographic TAM). Use for customer bridge analysis; do not use this as the only filter for total TAM market sizing."
    synonyms:
      - Customer Match Status
  - name: account
    expr: |-
      account
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Account
    comment: Selected decision-maker stakeholder for the building (for example tenant, owner, or property manager) used for account-level TAM analysis.
  - name: account_number_buildings_total
    expr: |-
      account_number_buildings_total
    display_name: "Fct Tam Buildings Account # Buildings"
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Account Number Buildings Total
      - Account Number Buildings
  - name: account_sf_total
    expr: |-
      account_sf_total
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Account Sf Total
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Account Sf Total
      - Account Sf
  - name: national_or_regional_account_flag
    expr: |-
      national_or_regional_account_flag
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings National or Regional
    synonyms:
      - National Or Regional Account Flag
  - name: property_manager_name
    expr: |-
      property_manager_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Property Manager Name
    comment: Property manager organization for the building.
    synonyms:
      - Property Manager Name
  - name: include_in_tam_property_manager
    expr: |-
      include_in_tam_property_manager
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Include In Tam Property Manager (Yes / No)
    synonyms:
      - Include In Tam Property Manager
  - name: key_tenant_name
    expr: |-
      key_tenant_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Key Tenant Name
    comment: Key tenant associated with the building, used in stakeholder-level market and account analysis.
    synonyms:
      - Key Tenant Name
  - name: include_in_tam_key_tenant
    expr: |-
      include_in_tam_key_tenant
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Include In Tam Key Tenant (Yes / No)
    synonyms:
      - Include In Tam Key Tenant
  - name: consolidated_sector_2
    expr: |-
      consolidated_sector_2_semantic
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Consolidated Facility Type
    comment: Top-level facility segmentation used for market sizing (Healthcare, Industrial, Manufacturing, Office, Residential, Retail, Specialty, Warehouse/Distribution).
    synonyms:
      - Consolidated Sector 2
  - name: consolidated_sector_2_sort
    expr: |-
      consolidated_sector_2_sort_semantic
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Consolidated Sector 2 Sort
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Consolidated Sector 2 Sort
  - name: sector_sort
    expr: |-
      sector_sort_semantic
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Sector Sort
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Sector Sort
  - name: branch
    expr: |-
      branch
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Branch
    comment: Operational branch location used for local service delivery (part of Region -> Territory -> Branch hierarchy).
  - name: region
    expr: |-
      region
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Region
    comment: Top-level sales geography used for leadership reporting and security filtering.
  - name: country
    expr: |-
      country
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Country
    comment: Country for the building location (United States or Canada).
  - name: vp_sales_name
    expr: |-
      vp_sales_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Sales VP Name
    synonyms:
      - Vp Sales Name
  - name: bdm_sales_name
    expr: |-
      bdm_sales_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Sales BDM Name
    synonyms:
      - Bdm Sales Name
  - name: outside_geographic_tam
    expr: |-
      outside_geographic_tam
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings View Customers Outside of Geographic TAM?
    comment: Flag used to identify customer records outside the formal geographic TAM definition.
    synonyms:
      - Outside Geographic Tam
  - name: geo_label_for_map
    expr: |-
      territory
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Geo Label for Map
    comment: Map-ready geography label based on territory. Use this for choropleth/map-layer visualizations with the custom GDI regions layer.
    synonyms:
      - Geo Label For Map
  - name: include_in_tam_account
    expr: |-
      include_in_tam_account
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Include In Tam Account (Yes / No)
    synonyms:
      - Include In Tam Account
  - name: in_extended_tam_scope_flag
    expr: |-
      in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings In Extended Tam Scope Flag (Yes / No)
    synonyms:
      - In Extended Tam Scope Flag
  - name: naics_code
    expr: |-
      naics_code_semantic
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Naics Code
    synonyms:
      - Naics Code
  - name: address
    expr: |-
      address
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Address
  - name: building_name
    expr: |-
      building_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Name
    synonyms:
      - Building Name
  - name: building_rba
    expr: |-
      building_rba
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Square Footage
    comment: Rentable Building Area (RBA) in square feet. Primary size field used in TAM qualification and revenue potential calculations.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Building Rba
  - name: building_status
    expr: |-
      building_status
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Status
    comment: Lifecycle status of the building (for example Existing, Under Construction, Demolished). Existing buildings are typically the TAM-eligible population.
    synonyms:
      - Building Status
  - name: city
    expr: |-
      city
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings City
    comment: City where the building is located.
  - name: cust_original_building_id
    expr: |-
      cust_original_building_id
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Cust Original Building ID
    synonyms:
      - Cust Original Building Id
  - name: cust_unified_building_id
    expr: |-
      cust_unified_building_id
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer ID
    comment: Unified customer-system building identifier used for customer-level distinct counts and customer match metrics.
    synonyms:
      - Cust Unified Building Id
  - name: customer_sf_estimate
    expr: |-
      customer_sf_estimate
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer SF Estimate (with No Market Data)
    comment: Estimated customer square footage used when market data is missing (No Market ID) so customer-adjusted TAM measures remain inclusive.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Customer Sf Estimate
  - name: secondary_type
    expr: |-
      secondary_type
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Facility Subtype
    synonyms:
      - Secondary Type
  - name: is_current_customer
    expr: |-
      is_current_customer
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Is Current Customer (Yes / No)
    comment: Yes if the building is currently serviced by GDI; No for prospects/non-customers.
    synonyms:
      - Is Current Customer
  - name: key_tenant_sf_total
    expr: |-
      key_tenant_sf_total
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Key Tenant Sf Total
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Key Tenant Sf Total
      - Key Tenant Sf
  - name: largest_tenant_name
    expr: |-
      largest_tenant_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Largest Tenant Name
    comment: Largest tenant identified for the building.
    synonyms:
      - Largest Tenant Name
  - name: latitude
    expr: |-
      latitude
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Latitude
    comment: Latitude coordinate for mapping.
    format:
      type: number
  - name: longitude
    expr: |-
      longitude
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Longitude
    comment: Longitude coordinate for mapping.
    format:
      type: number
  - name: naics
    expr: |-
      naics
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Naics
  - name: owner_sf_total
    expr: |-
      owner_sf_total
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Owner Sf Total
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Owner Sf Total
      - Owner Sf
  - name: parent_cust_sf_estimate
    expr: |-
      parent_cust_sf_estimate
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Parent Customer SF Estimate (with No Market Data)
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Parent Cust Sf Estimate
  - name: property_id
    expr: |-
      property_id
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Property ID
    comment: Primary key for TAM buildings; unique building identifier and the recommended join key for building-grain analysis.
    synonyms:
      - Property Id
  - name: property_manager_sf_total
    expr: |-
      property_manager_sf_total
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Property Manager Sf Total
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Property Manager Sf Total
      - Property Manager Sf
  - name: state
    expr: |-
      state
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings State
    comment: State or province where the building is located.
  - name: industry
    expr: |-
      industry
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Tenant Industry
  - name: zip
    expr: |-
      zip
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Zip
measures:
  - name: buildings_count_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Buildings in TAM
    comment: Distinct TAM-eligible building count in the extended TAM scope. Use as the denominator for penetration-style TAM KPIs.
    format:
      type: percentage
    synonyms:
      - Buildings Count Customer Adjusted
      - Buildings Customer Adjusted
  - name: revenue_estimate_sum_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN revenue_estimate_usd
            ELSE revenue_estimate_cad
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings TAM Revenue Estimate ($)
    comment: Estimated total revenue opportunity across extended TAM scope. Generally modeled as building SF multiplied by facility-type rate.
    format:
      type: percentage
    synonyms:
      - Revenue Estimate Sum Customer Adjusted
      - Revenue Estimate Customer Adjusted
  - name: building_sf_occupied_by_account_adjusted_sum
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN COALESCE(building_sf_occupied_by_account, customer_sf_estimate)
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building SF in TAM
    comment: Total TAM square footage using occupied SF when available and customer SF estimate fallback for missing market data.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Building Sf Occupied By Account Adjusted Sum
      - Building Sf Occupied By Account Adjusted
  - name: avg_acct_sf_per_building_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN COALESCE(building_sf_occupied_by_account, customer_sf_estimate)
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
          ELSE NULL
        END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Average Building Size (Sq Ft)
    comment: "Average TAM building size in square feet. Formula: Building SF in TAM / Buildings in TAM."
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Avg Acct Sf Per Building Customer Adjusted
      - Acct Sf Per Building Customer Adjusted
  - name: max_rate
    expr: |-
      PERCENTILE_APPROX(
        CASE
          WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN rate_usd
          ELSE rate_cad
        END,
        0.5
      )
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Facility Type Estimated Revenue $ / Sq Ft
    comment: Median facility-type revenue rate per square foot used as a pricing benchmark for TAM revenue estimation.
    format:
      type: percentage
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
    synonyms:
      - Max Rate
      - Rate
  - name: customers_site_count_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN (customer_match_status <> 'Not a Customer' OR customer_match_status IS NULL)
         AND in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN cust_unified_building_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings GDI Customer Sites
    comment: Distinct count of customer sites included in the extended TAM scope (includes eligible No Market ID logic).
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Customers Site Count Adjusted
      - Customers Site Adjusted
  - name: building_penetration_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN (customer_match_status <> 'Not a Customer' OR customer_match_status IS NULL)
         AND in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN cust_unified_building_id
        ELSE NULL
      END) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
          ELSE NULL
        END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Penetration %
    comment: "Share of TAM buildings currently serviced by GDI. Formula: GDI Customer Sites / Buildings in TAM."
    format:
      type: percentage
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 1
    synonyms:
      - Building Penetration Customer Adjusted
  - name: customer_acv_year_sum_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_acv_year_usd
            ELSE customer_acv_year
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings GDI Annualized Revenue ($)
    comment: Total annualized customer contract value within extended TAM scope. This is actual customer revenue, not estimated TAM potential.
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
      hide_group_separator: false
    synonyms:
      - Customer Acv Year Sum Customer Adjusted
      - Customer Acv Year Customer Adjusted
  - name: revenue_share_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_acv_year_usd
            ELSE customer_acv_year
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
            CASE
              WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN revenue_estimate_usd
              ELSE revenue_estimate_cad
            END
          ELSE NULL
        END), 0), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Revenue Share %
    comment: "GDI revenue share within TAM. Formula: GDI Annualized Revenue / TAM Revenue Estimate."
    format:
      type: percentage
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 1
    synonyms:
      - Revenue Share Customer Adjusted
  - name: customer_gross_profit_sum_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_gross_profit_usd
            ELSE customer_gross_profit_cad
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Gross Profit
    comment: Total gross profit from customer contracts across the extended TAM scope.
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
      hide_group_separator: false
    synonyms:
      - Customer Gross Profit Sum Customer Adjusted
      - Customer Gross Profit Customer Adjusted
  - name: customer_gross_margin_customer_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_gross_profit_usd
            ELSE customer_gross_profit_cad
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE
          WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN
            CASE
              WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_revenue_usd
              ELSE customer_revenue_cad
            END
          ELSE NULL
        END), 0), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Gross Margin
    comment: "Gross margin percentage for customer business in scope. Formula: Customer Gross Profit / Customer Revenue."
    format:
      type: percentage
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 1
    synonyms:
      - Customer Gross Margin Customer Adjusted
  - name: customer_acv_year_sum_outside_tam
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN NOT COALESCE(in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default, FALSE) THEN
          CASE
            WHEN upper(currency_selector) = 'USD' THEN customer_acv_year_usd
            ELSE customer_acv_year
          END
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Annual Contract Value Outside TAM
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
      hide_group_separator: false
    synonyms:
      - Customer Acv Year Sum Outside Tam
      - Customer Acv Year Outside Tam
  - name: customers_site_count_outside_tam
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN NOT COALESCE(in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default, FALSE)
          THEN cust_unified_building_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Sites Outside TAM Count
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Customers Site Count Outside Tam
      - Customers Site Outside Tam
  - name: building_penetration
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN (customer_match_status <> 'Not a Customer' OR customer_match_status IS NULL)
         AND in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN cust_unified_building_id
        ELSE NULL
      END) * 1.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
          WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
          ELSE NULL
        END), 0)
    display_name: Building Penetration
  - name: buildings_count
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Buildings Count
    synonyms:
      - Buildings
  - name: buildings_count_coverage_adjusted
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default THEN property_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Buildings Count Coverage Adjusted
    synonyms:
      - Buildings Coverage Adjusted
  - name: customers_site_count
    expr: |-
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN (customer_match_status <> 'Not a Customer' OR customer_match_status IS NULL)
         AND in_extended_tam_scope_flag_default
          THEN cust_unified_building_id
        ELSE NULL
      END)
    display_name: Customers Site Count
    synonyms:
      - Customers Site
  - name: acv_match_out_of_tam_building_size
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded < 100k Sq Ft'
          THEN customer_acv_year / 1000000.0
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: "Fct Tam Buildings ACV Matched: Excluded < 100k Sq Ft"
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
      hide_group_separator: false
    synonyms:
      - Acv Match Out Of Tam Building Size
  - name: acv_match_out_of_tam_less_than_20k
    expr: |-
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded < 20k Sq Ft'
          THEN customer_acv_year / 1000000.0
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0)
    display_name: "Fct Tam Buildings ACV Matched: Excluded < 20k Sq Ft"
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
      decimal_places:
        type: exact
        places: 2
      hide_group_separator: false
    synonyms:
      - Acv Match Out Of Tam Less Than 20k
parameters:
  - name: currency_selector
    data_type: STRING
    default: "'CAD'"
  - name: square_footage_threshold
